$schema: mlr-app architecture map — a single reference artifact for AI agents working on this codebase

meta.generatedBy: Claude architecture-mapping pass (6 parallel subagents + direct reads)
meta.purpose: A private, family-only PWA for a small family lake resort/club near Tomahawk, WI (EST 1987). NOT a commercial booking product — it is closed-community social software: browse public, verified email unlocks interaction (posts/chat/RSVP/polls/etc).
meta.audience: An extended family of mixed ages and technical ability, organized into 'houses' (family branches) and volunteer 'committees'. Admins are promoted family members, not staff.
meta.howToUse: Sections under `architecture` map the app as-is. `designSystem` + `motionKitToPort` describe the current look/motion and the target polish (ported from the sibling stock-game app). `hardConstraints` are rules that must never be broken. `improvementOpportunities` is an actionable backlog (tunnels, workflows, efficiencies, product, ui/ux-motion, chatUpgrade) — each item is scoped for a single focused PR and names the files it touches. `implementationPlan` orders them into waves. A cheaper model can safely execute a single opportunity item by reading the files it references plus the relevant architecture + constraints sections.
meta.twoClients: One Supabase backend serves TWO clients: this Next.js web PWA (Vercel) AND a native SwiftUI iOS app (mlr-app-ios, iOS 26). Any schema/RPC/realtime change must preserve parity — a web-only change can silently break iOS.
keyDocs: docs/professional-app-plan.md (2026-07-12 audit, partially stale — verify against CLAUDE.md)

domainGlossary.MLR: Muskellunge Lake Resort — the umbrella app/brand. Forest-green cabin-in-the-pines logo, light-mode only, EST 1987. The universal baseline: everyone is always MLR.
domainGlossary.Family Fest: The one-week annual family gathering — a built-in section at /family-fest/* with its own Renaissance/parchment theme (Cinzel font) + sub-nav. Has a 4-phase 'season' (off-season -> planning -> live -> wrap) from lib/festSeason.ts, mirrored byte-for-byte in the retiring standalone family-fest repo.
domainGlossary.House: A family-branch group (e.g. 'MJT House'). Admin-assigned, at most one per member (profiles.house_id FK). Gets private chat, scoped work items, a shared stay calendar, and a House Hub (/house).
domainGlossary.Committee: A volunteer group (e.g. Beautification, Family Fest). Static display roster (lib/data.ts) + DB membership (committee_roster/committee_members) that gates chat. Family Fest members have 'roles[]' = areas, each its own chat channel. Admins create/rename/archive ('delete'=archive).
domainGlossary.Committee Lead: A role suffix ' · Lead' — can organize meetings and edit their own fest items.
domainGlossary.Work item / Work Checklist: A to-do list (WorkChecklist.tsx), MLR-wide or house-scoped, each with urgency (asap/this_year/nice_to_have), optional media + comment thread.
domainGlossary.Work Weekend: A real-world resort maintenance event type (seed event). Distinct from the generic work-item feature.
domainGlossary.Cabin / 'place to stay': A bookable lodging unit (cabins table), kind cabin|house, optional named rooms, per-place approver (need not be an admin).
domainGlossary.Tee times: A hand-off (not in-app booking) from Local Places to Inshalla CC's foreUP booking via /tee-times.
domainGlossary.Dues: Family Fest payment tiers (flat or per-day), calculated by FestDuesCalculator, paid via Venmo/Zelle/etc deep links in PayView. No payment processor.
domainGlossary.Ask for Help: A member at the resort posts a request; willing+present members get pinged. 'At the resort' presence is inferred (no GPS) from event RSVPs ±2 days or approved cabin stays. Urgent bypasses targeting.
domainGlossary.Family polls: Any signed-in member can create a poll (2-10 options); one changeable vote each.
domainGlossary.Meeting scheduler: Doodle/when2meet-style tool pinned to a committee/house chat, or family-wide, finalizing into a Google Meet link or a real calendar Event.
domainGlossary.Home callouts: Admin-managed temporary swipe-away announcement cards on Home (home_callouts), distinct from the permanent Family Fest spotlight and the Announcement banner.
domainGlossary.Announcement banner: Admin notices at the top of the app, auto-expiring; unified with push/email/Activity under AdminBroadcastComposer.
domainGlossary.Preview As / View As: Admin-only, device-local, UI-only role override to check the privacy wall as a member/guest. Never touches the real session, never persists.

conventions.caching: useCachedResource everywhere. FOUR HARD RULES: (1) memory seeds read sync in useState initializers; persisted seeds ONLY inside post-mount effects (else hydration mismatch). (2) user-scoped keys embed the auth uid (e.g. feed.<uid>, events.<uid|guest>, chatRoom.<uid>.<slug>|<area>); pass key=null while uid unresolved. (3) Preview mode never persists (persist: undefined, preview id in a memory-only key). (4) signOut() calls clearAllCaches().
conventions.reads: Direct supabase.from(table).select() from domain modules, guarded by RLS. Every module degrades (never throws): no config -> seed/empty; 42P01 missing table / PGRST202 missing RPC -> seed/[]/false. Several features merge a live DB read with the lib/data.ts seed.
conventions.writes: Auth-sensitive / business-rule writes go through SECURITY DEFINER RPCs, never raw client insert (set_event_attendance, request_cabin_stay, create_committee, cast_poll_vote, create_meeting, send_broadcast_notification, mark_work_item_done). Simple own-row tables (reactions, home_callout_completions, work_item_comments) write directly (RLS is the gate). Service-role actions (invite, set-email) proxy the mini.
conventions.roles: Three tiers server-enforced: App Admin (profiles.is_admin — DB is single source of truth, NO client allow-list, column-level GRANT blocks self-escalation) > Committee Lead (committee_members.role='Lead' or roster roles[] ending ' Lead', scoped) > Member. Houses have no Lead. Cabin approver (cabins.approver_user_id) is a narrow non-admin delegation.
conventions.tenantConfig: Single-tenant. resort_config = admin-editable help contact (public-read). Broader identity is lib/data.ts seed, progressively made live via fest_* content tables + home_callouts + app_images (read via festContent.ts / appImages.ts, always seed-fallback).

chat.summary: The make-or-break feature. Two rooms — HouseChat + CommitteeChat — are NEAR-DUPLICATED (share MessageRow/MessageText/ChatShell pattern, not code). Hosted by FeedView (Feed tab) inside a viewport-pinned, keyboard-aware fixed container with chat-push/chat-pop slide. Feature-rich (media/reactions/@mentions/replies/24h edit+soft-delete/unread/meeting bar) but under-animated vs iMessage.

dataFlow.storage: house_messages / committee_messages (+ _media/_reactions/_mentions) + house_reads/committee_area_reads (room-level read marker only).
dataFlow.initialLoad: refetchMessages() runs SEQUENTIALLY: select messages -> Promise.all(media, reactions, mentions, ALL profiles UNFILTERED, roster) -> join client-side -> setMessages -> snapshot (last 30) to memory Map + localStorage -> mark_*_read RPC.
dataFlow.liveUpdates: Supabase Realtime postgres_changes '*' on all 4 tables -> debounceRefetch(120ms) -> the SAME full-pipeline refetch. NO incremental patch — every change replaces the whole array.
dataFlow.send: NOT optimistic. Uploads files serially -> insert message -> insert media/mentions -> clear composer -> await full refetch before the bubble appears. Perceived latency = full round trip.
dataFlow.reactions: long-press 420ms tray -> toggleReaction upsert/delete -> full refetch (no optimistic pill). Tapping a pill toggles a client-only 'who reacted' expansion.
dataFlow.readReceipts: room-level only (house_reads/committee_area_reads last_read_at) — drives Feed unread badge. No per-message Read/Delivered, no unread divider.
dataFlow.typing: NONE. lib/presence.ts is a different feature (resort-wide, not chat).

painPoints.gap: No optimistic send — bubble appears only after upload+insert+full refetch
Every mutation (even one reaction) triggers a full refetch incl. the ENTIRE unfiltered profiles table
No message-appear spring/fade — bubbles snap in (the app's own .rise/.pop utilities are unused here)
No haptics anywhere (note: iOS Safari has no Vibration API — Android-only progressive enhancement)
Scroll-to-bottom on new msg / keyboard is an instant jump, not smooth
No scroll-to-bottom pill/FAB when scrolled up and a new message arrives
No unread divider inside a room
Realtime full-refetch behind flat 120ms debounce — bursts = repeated full reloads
No skeleton for the message list once access is known but messages still loading
No upload-progress UI (uploadToMini supports onProgress; composers don't wire it)
Chat attachments stack vertically instead of reusing MediaGrid carousel; videos don't open Lightbox
Standalone ChatShell (CommitteeChatRoute / non-embedded) has NO entrance animation, unlike FeedView's chat-push
Long-press reaction tray has no open/close transition (Lightbox-style pop-panel exists)
Swipe-to-reply is linear 1:1 with a hard cutoff — no rubber-band, no progressive icon ramp
Composer textarea height snaps (no transition); delete uses native window.confirm; images have no aspect-ratio reservation (pop-in shift)

Missing vs stock-game: physics springs (framer-motion), animated numbers, FLIP list reorder, shared-element segmented pill, message-appear, typing dots, P3/HDR color.

motionKitToPort.principle: stock-game's 'buttery' feel is ~70% the SAME CSS foundation mlr-app already has (motion tokens + .press + CSS sheets/transitions) PLUS framer-motion for a few physics moments. hdrColor.mechanism: @supports (color: color(display-p3 1 1 1)) upgrade layer over the sRGB hex source (hex stays fallback/source of truth). NO oklch. SVG attrs need a useP3() JS hook (starts false through first paint for hydration safety).
hdrColor.applyTo: richer P3 variants of --color-primary (forest green), --color-accent/campfire, --color-lake, --color-sun, --color-dusk, --color-fest — deeper, more saturated on P3 displays while preserving the exact light Northwoods identity. Neutrals stay sRGB (wide-gamut grays read tinted).

motionKitToPort.portingNotes: 1) Add motion tokens + reduced-motion global guard FIRST. 2) Mount MotionProvider once. 3) Port AnimatedNumber (zero deps) -> AnimatedList -> RangeTabs -> TabBar pop -> Celebration. 4) Keep page transitions CSS-only (a lingering framer transform re-roots position:fixed overlays — mlr already documents this). 5) Test each against prefers-reduced-motion emulation.

hardConstraints: LIGHT MODE ONLY forever. Never add a dark theme. Never use a dark translucent surface tint (bg-black/NN, bg-zinc-*/NN) as a card/panel bg (goes muddy grey) — bg-black/NN is OK only as a modal scrim.
Never hard-code hex in components — add/edit a --color-* token in globals.css @theme.
profiles.is_admin & house_id are NEVER client-writable (column GRANT + insert guard). No client admin allow-list.
RLS is the real privacy gate, not the UI (migration 0081 lockdown). Any new sensitive field/table needs matching RLS. UI hiding is insufficient.
resort_config help-contact stays PUBLIC-read (it's the sign-in escape hatch). Don't lock it down.
No PII in the client bundle (lib/data.ts seed = names/roles only; lib/help.ts is a neutral placeholder).
Committee/role/cabin 'delete' = archive (archived_at), never destructive. Slugs are immutable.
24h edit / soft-delete window on messages is enforced in RLS, not just UI — preserve server-side.
Preview/'View as' is UI-only, never touches the real session, never persists (SWR rule 3).
Any schema/RPC/realtime change must preserve iOS app (mlr-app-ios) parity — it reads the same tables.
Supabase migrations are handed to Brian as SQL to run; do NOT apply autonomously without explicit authorization.
Respect notification prefs (notif_types/push_types); only help_urgent intentionally bypasses per-category push.
Do NOT reintroduce pull-to-refresh (deliberately removed — realtime + UpdateBanner cover it).
The SWR cache four rules (memory-sync/storage-in-effect, uid-scoped keys, preview-never-persists, signOut clears) — breaking them causes hydration mismatch or cross-account data bleed.
Do NOT touch stock-game or innjoy-mobile from this repo — reference only.
When adding a route/dependency/env var/data-model change, update CLAUDE.md + README.md in the same commit.

improvementOpportunities.legend: Each item: id, title, why, files, effort (S/M/L), risk (low/med/high), dependsOn. Grouped by category. A cheaper model can execute one item by reading its files + relevant architecture/constraints.

tunnels.title: Home -> House Chat direct tunnel
tunnels.why: The user's flagship example. Today: Home HouseHubCard -> /house hub -> 'House chat' card -> /posts?house=<slug> (2 hops). Add a dedicated chat affordance on HouseHubCard that deep-links straight to /posts?house=<slug> (FeedView already opens the room from this param), AND add a /house/chat route mirroring /committees/[slug]/chat for a flash-free, correct-back entry.

tunnels.title: Home 'Jump back in' recent-chats strip
tunnels.why: Surface the viewer's most-active rooms (house + committees) with unread badges as horizontal chips on Home, each deep-linking straight into the room. Reuses FeedView's summary/unread logic + chatEntry cache.

tunnels.title: Scroll-to-and-highlight a linked message (?m=<id>)
tunnels.why: Chat @mention notifications deep-link ?m=<id> but the room doesn't scroll to / flash that message. Implement scroll+highlight (like PostsView's ?post= flash).

tunnels.title: Event -> committee chat / linked work items tunnels
tunnels.why: From EventSheet, one-tap to the relevant committee chat area or the event's linked work items — instead of navigating manually.

tunnels.title: 'Message the chef/lead' tunnel from fest cards
tunnels.why: Fest dinner/schedule cards show a chef/lead — add a direct link into the Family Fest committee area chat (or a MemberSheet contact).

tunnels.title: WhosUpNorth / roster avatars -> MemberSheet everywhere
tunnels.why: Consistent one-tap into a person's card from every avatar (some already do). Audit + unify so every avatar is a tunnel.

tunnels.title: Family Fest tab -> live day schedule during live week
tunnels.why: During isLive, the Family Fest tab could deep-scroll to 'today at the fest' instead of the top of Overview.

workflows.title: Extract a shared chat core from HouseChat + CommitteeChat
workflows.why: ~1000 lines of near-duplicated code. A shared useChatRoom hook + ChatRoom/MessageRow/Composer components means every polish/perf fix lands ONCE and keeps web/iOS-parity logic in one place. Foundational for the chat upgrade.
workflows.note: Do behind a careful diff — chat is critical. Land before the chat-UX items so they only touch one place.

workflows.title: Optimistic send
workflows.why: Append the bubble locally the instant Send is tapped (pending state), reconcile on realtime echo. The single biggest perceived-latency win.

workflows.title: Incremental realtime patching
workflows.why: Stop replacing the whole array + refetching the entire profiles table on every event. Patch the single changed row; cache a profile map. Perf + smoothness.

workflows.title: Optimistic reaction toggle
workflows.why: Toggle the pill locally, no refetch.

workflows.title: Meeting scheduling reachable from more entry points
workflows.why: Currently buried in the room ⋯ menu. Surface for organizers on the committee detail page + relevant Home/Events contexts.

efficiencies.title: Scope the chat profiles query
efficiencies.why: refetchMessages selects the ENTIRE profiles table every time. Scope to message authors present, or cache a shared profile map. Big data reduction.

efficiencies.title: Batch/dedupe Home delight-card reads
efficiencies.why: WeatherCard, WhosUpNorth, ActivePoll, Birthdays, OnThisDay each read Supabase independently on Home. Some share data (events/attendance). Consolidate where cheap.

efficiencies.title: next/image for remote media
efficiencies.why: next.config.ts has no images.remotePatterns, so mini/Supabase media isn't optimized. Add remotePatterns + use next/image for post/chat thumbnails (perf, LCP).
efficiencies.note: Media URLs are stored verbatim; verify the mini serves proper caching headers (it does — 365d immutable).

efficiencies.title: Migrate remaining bespoke caches to useCachedResource
efficiencies.why: CommitteeRoster, CommitteeJoin, Admin* still use hand-rolled memory caches. Opportunistic consistency win.

productOptimizations.title: Typing indicators
productOptimizations.why: Core iMessage-parity signal. Use Supabase Realtime broadcast/presence on the room channel (ephemeral, no table).

productOptimizations.title: Unread divider in-room
productOptimizations.why: '—— New ——' line at the first unread message on open, using the existing last_read_at BEFORE it's overwritten.

productOptimizations.title: Scroll-to-bottom pill w/ new-message count
productOptimizations.why: When scrolled up and a message arrives, show a floating pill (AnimatedNumber count) that smooth-scrolls down on tap.

productOptimizations.title: Draft persistence per room
productOptimizations.why: Keep a composer draft per room (sessionStorage) so switching rooms doesn't lose typing.

productOptimizations.title: Reuse MediaGrid carousel in chat + open video in Lightbox
productOptimizations.why: Multi-photo messages stack vertically today; videos never open Lightbox. Reuse the shared carousel for consistency.

productOptimizations.title: 1:1 direct messages (bigger swing)
productOptimizations.why: No DMs today — only group rooms. A common expectation. Requires a new table + RLS + iOS parity consideration. Scope carefully; likely a later phase.

uiuxMotion.title: Add framer-motion + MotionProvider foundation
uiuxMotion.why: The base for all physics motion. Add dep, port MotionProvider (reducedMotion='user'), mount in layout. Update README/CLAUDE.md.

uiuxMotion.title: P3/HDR color layer
uiuxMotion.why: The 'HDR colors' ask. Add @supports display-p3 variants of the brand palette over the sRGB source, preserving the light Northwoods identity. Add useP3() for any SVG that needs it.

uiuxMotion.title: AnimatedNumber across the app
uiuxMotion.why: Count-up for vote counts (PollsView/ActivePollCard), dues totals (FestDuesCalculator/PayView), RSVP/attendance tallies (EventSheet/AttendanceControl), unread badges (TabBar), help 'n/N covered'.

uiuxMotion.title: AnimatedList FLIP reorder
uiuxMotion.why: People directory (search filter), Feed conversation list (sort by most-recent), poll result bars re-ranking as votes land.

uiuxMotion.title: Shared-element segmented pill (RangeTabs pattern)
uiuxMotion.why: AttendanceControl (Going/Maybe/Can't) + FamilyFestNav pills get a gliding active pill instead of a hard swap.

uiuxMotion.title: TabBar active-icon pop + polish
uiuxMotion.why: tabPop keyframe (key-to-replay trick) on tab switch + accent dot fade. Small, high-visibility.

uiuxMotion.title: Celebration/confetti moments
uiuxMotion.why: RSVP 'Going', poll vote cast, help 'Covered', dues paid. CSS confetti + accent banner, guarded once-per-event.

uiuxMotion.title: Chat message spring-in + reaction tray spring + smooth scroll
uiuxMotion.why: The core chat feel. AnimatePresence on new bubbles (subtle scale/opacity/translate spring), pop-panel on the reaction tray, smooth (not instant) scroll-to-bottom.

uiuxMotion.title: Chat composer + send polish
uiuxMotion.why: Animate textarea grow, send-button morph (arrow -> spinner -> check), pending-bubble shimmer, upload progress ring (wire uploadToMini onProgress).

uiuxMotion.title: Haptic ticks (progressive enhancement)
uiuxMotion.why: navigator.vibrate on send/react/long-press/swipe-commit — Android-only (iOS Safari has no Vibration API), so a small win, safe no-op elsewhere. Wrap in one lib/haptics.ts helper.

uiuxMotion.title: Chat message-list skeleton + image aspect-ratio reservation
uiuxMotion.why: SkeletonList while messages load (access known, cache empty); reserve img aspect-ratio from stored width/height to stop pop-in shift.

uiuxMotion.title: Standalone ChatShell entrance parity
uiuxMotion.why: CommitteeChatRoute (/committees/[slug]/chat) has no entrance animation; give it the chat-push slide for consistency.

uiuxMotion.title: In-app action sheet to replace window.confirm
uiuxMotion.why: Delete-message uses native window.confirm — replace with an iOS-style action sheet (Sheet primitive) for consistency.

implementationPlan.approach: Ship in small, isolated PRs (auto-ship convention). Foundation first, then the chat overhaul (behind a shared core so fixes land once), then the app-wide motion sweep, then product additions. Each wave is independently shippable and reviewable on the live site.

waves.name: Motion foundation
waves.rationale: Low-risk base every later item builds on; immediately visible polish (tabs, richer color).

waves.name: App-wide motion sweep
waves.rationale: High-visibility delight across polls/events/dues/people using the wave-1 base. No chat risk.

waves.name: Chat core + performance
waves.rationale: The make-or-break work. Refactor first so all chat polish/perf lands in one place. Highest care.

waves.name: Chat feel (iMessage bar)
waves.rationale: The visible chat buttery-ness, on top of the wave-3 core.

waves.name: Chat product features
waves.rationale: Feature-parity signals that make chat sticky.

waves.name: Tunnels & shortcuts
waves.rationale: Navigation efficiency; can run in parallel with any wave since mostly additive.

waves.name: Efficiencies & bigger swings
waves.rationale: Perf cleanup + a possible larger product bet (DMs) once the core feels great.
